operations: Run overlay permission/lifecycle/privacy scenarios on representative emulator and real device.
Run accessible chart/list/drill-down proof using non-sensitive synthetic data.
Record exact devices, steps, observations, limitations, and go/no-go recommendations.
planner.rollback: Keep all spike code disposable and outside production source. Preserve proof-template and ADR baselines before any edits; revert only task-owned proof/document changes if a review rejects them. No user data is used.

securityPreflight.scope: Disposable BT-003 spike only: synthetic values and IDs; dedicated/owner-authorized emulator and real device; record model/API/build and serial alias, not raw serials; package ID must be unique and no replace-install; grant/revoke SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW only through that package's user-visible settings; blank/neutral background for overlay checks; redact screenshots/notifications/incidental personal data; state-transition-only logs; FGS policy research only unless justified with valid type/permission/notification and permitted start path; disable overlay and revoke only spike permission after capture; no unrelated data/app cleanup. D-01 and D-06 stay open. No build/device command until coordinator runs check-start.

findings.description: Reviewer required dedicated/owner-authorized devices, no raw serials, exact unique spike package, user-visible permission flow only, synthetic/redacted captures, no forced FGS/background-start behavior, and scoped cleanup. Coordinator must follow these restrictions.
